exactVersionRefusal.purpose: Confirm artifact metadata and the runtime exact-version refusal agree on the installed candidate artifacts, using a nearby unsupported negative case for each changed language interface, per issue #171's acceptance criterion.

python.negativeCase: langgraph==1.2.9 (the adjacent patch immediately below the supported 1.2.10-1.2.11 range; 1.2.12 does not exist on PyPI as of this qualification)
python.outcome: Both agent_topology.langgraph.describe() and the `agt describe` CLI (installed from the same wheel) raise/report UnsupportedLangGraphVersionError naming the exact tested versions (1.2.10, 1.2.11) and an install remediation command; CLI exits 5.

typescript.negativeCase: @langchain/langgraph@1.4.15-rc.0 (a real published prerelease immediately above the supported 1.4.14; installed as a single deduped copy via npm `overrides`, since the producer's own package.json pins @langchain/langgraph as an exact regular dependency, not a peer, so a plain `npm install` of the tarball always nests its own 1.4.14 copy alongside any differently-versioned top-level install -- refusal is only reachable when a consumer's tooling forces one shared instance, e.g. npm overrides/resolutions, a monorepo hoisting a single copy, or Yarn PnP)
typescript.outcome: describe() from the installed tarball rejects with UnsupportedLangGraphVersionError naming the exact tested version (1.4.14) and an install remediation command.
